title: Divisibility Map
description: Generate a labeled sequence that maps divisibility rules into readable tags.
prompt: Build a function that produces a sequence from 1 to n. Multiples of 3 become Fizz, multiples of 5 become Buzz, and multiples of both become FizzBuzz.

sampleCode.ruby:
def divisibility_map(n)
  result = []
  (1..n).each do |value|
    if value % 15 == 0
      result << 'FizzBuzz'
    elsif value % 3 == 0
      result << 'Fizz'
    elsif value % 5 == 0
      result << 'Buzz'
    else
      result << value.to_s
    end
  end
  result
end
